content: The Deendayal Research Institute (DRI) focuses on conflict-free and self-reliant villages, particularly in water-scarce and tribal-dominated areas. It has established an Ayurveda Research Laboratory and manufactures nearly three hundred Ayurvedic drugs. DRI's projects emphasize climate-resilient agriculture, income generation, water and sanitation, and health, with a commitment to sustainability and replicability. The organization has received recognition from the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and the Ministry of Science & Technology in India.
